holiday: monday 26th october is a bank holiday. daily mass will be at 11am . winter time: winter time begins this weekend. please put back your clocks one hour on saturday night/sunday morning. mass times on sunday will be on wintertime. this will continue until easter sunday 28th march 2027 when summertime will begin. holy souls november remembrance: during the month of november we will remember all our loved ones who have departed from this life. it is a time of the year in which our departed loved ones are very near to us and in our thoughts. masses will offered for our departed loved ones during the month of november. please leave an envelope with those you wish to remember and your offering in the box placed in the church before each mass, or drop into the parish office and we will include your loved ones in our mass es. feel free to add the name of your loved one to our remembrance tree which is in the sanctuary of the church by writing their names on the tags of those speci al to you. details of blessing of graves in last week’s newsletter and of the mass times in november. feast of all saints: sunday next is 1st november, the feast of all saints. mass for the feast day will be the normal saturday/sunday mass times in the parish. feast of all souls: monday is the feast of all souls. masses for the feast day. clarecastle - 10.00am ballyea - 7.00pm community education: an lcetb course titled “move, create, feel good ” will begin in clarecastle day care centre starting on thursday 19th november from 11.30am to 1.00pm. details on enrolling is on the notice board in the church porch. remembering the dead: there will be an evening mass in ballyea church on the wednesdays of november at 7.00pm . morning mass in clarecastle each week day at 10.00am. bereavement mass : the annual commemoration masses in remembrance of all who died from november last year to the present will be organised by the parish bereavement group will be as follows: wednesday 25th november clarecastle church 7.00pm friday 27th november ballyea church 7.00pm history of clare youth club 1969-2026: a group has been formed to compile a history of youth clubs in clare from 1969-2026. we are hoping to make contact with all youth clubs throughout the county (1969-2026) who were active during those years. an information sheet will be distributed to each club contact per son, and we ask you to please forward information to us by friday 30th october. if you need further information, please contact jim mcmahon

. mass can also be heard on radio 106.3fm . the popes intentions – october for mental health ministry let us pray that the mental health ministry be established throughout the church, helping to overcome the stigma and discrimination of persons with mental illnesses.
